The current Definition already specifies normalized incoming and outgoing waves, the exact scattering solution, current, and T(h). The assigned barrier proof now derives the normalization and current ratio explicitly.

The current stable weighted Airy supplier derives its kernel estimate from the phase weights; it does not assume the false monotonicity of e_h. No supplier edit was needed.

Replaced the unsupported basis conversion with explicit bounded exterior matrices and their inverses, derived the interior Wronskian estimate, and related it to the exact normalized scattering current.

Defined the uncompressed field interaction on its maximal multiplication domain and proved unboundedness below using translated compactly supported test functions with explicit kinetic, Coulomb, and field terms.
Stated eigenvalues with multiplicity and separated gamma=0 and lambda=0. Updated the example remark, companion scope remark, and B-page summary.
The current prefactor identity already has coefficient 16. Qualified the prefactor comparison as one that can differ from one and recorded the ratios where it equals one; updated the B-page summary.
